coverageSpotVerification.detail: Every mapped test was read and traced to its assertion's observable, and all 58 suite-required assertions in scope were independently re-executed by the grader with agreeing results. The manifest maps exactly the 58 suite-required assertions of the 7 in-scope milestones (M1 7, M2 22, M3 7, M4 5, M5 6, M6 5, M8 6) with no gaps and no padding: no assertion is mapped to a test that does not exercise it. Two mappings are thin but not dishonest: the test behind m2-a24 checks cursor dedup and full-set presence but not page-size uniformity, and the test behind m2-a12 checks a role=link node but not that tapping it reaches the system browser. The grader closed both gaps directly (16 Global pages with zero duplicate event ids and all 24 seeded posts present; window.open called with the exact URL and _blank). No milestone is adjudicated capability-failure on coverage grounds.

defects.summary: The replay adapter is not idempotent across a genuine re-replay. With the resume state file absent, profile-set re-uploads the avatar and reuses the same derived mutation id with different arguments, so the second action aborts the whole replay with E_ID_REUSED - contrary to the action schema's rule that a create verb's explicit id is a stable idempotency key whose retry behaviour is idempotent.
defects.evidence: grading/trace.md#d-03 (grading/logs/replay-sample-forced.log: E_ID_REUSED at scripts/replay.mjs:11, action 2 of sample-50.log)

defects.summary: API.md's "With only a token and this document" section tells a reader to POST /auth/login but never gives the response shape. The raw route answers {session:{...}} with no ok flag, while the SDK section above documents success as {ok:true,session:...}; a client written strictly from the HTTP section therefore fails its own success check on a successful login.
defects.evidence: grading/trace.md#d-04 (grader m6-a12 first attempt: HTTP 200 with a valid session but no `ok` field)

defects.summary: The documented operational scripts are not safe for an operator other than the original session: start-servers.mjs, build-web.mjs, restart-backend.mjs and replay.mjs append to run-log.md and overwrite evidence/*.pid unconditionally, and restart-backend.mjs kills whatever pid is in evidence/backend.pid, so an independent operator running the documented entrypoints mutates the delivered record and cannot restart a backend they started themselves.

O1.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and the 90 anchor ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts"), interpolated nearer 90 than 60.
O1.justification: 101 of the 119 frozen assertions pass under independent grader execution; 7 of the 8 in-scope milestones are green (M1-M6 and M8), with M7 never attempted. The lane is well past the 60 anchor: M1-M5 are not merely solid but complete (all 79 of their assertions pass, including every [grader]-class obligation - argon2id storage, server-side session revocation, the shortened edit window, asset revocation after delete and after view-once, and server-enforced expiry with no client open), and M6 and M8 are green on the web carrier with all five M8 digest obligations exact. It is held below 90 by exactly the two things that anchor names: not every in-scope milestone is green (M7's 9 assertions are not-run - instructed by ENVIRONMENT.md, which is attribution, not completeness credit, since nothing is struck in this run), and the platform-proof artifacts are entirely absent (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17, m8-a18: no simulator recording, no structured native receipts, no run manifest). Quality of what does pass is high - every suite-required assertion was re-executed independently and agreed, and the two thin coverage mappings were closed by the grader. Evidence: grading/trace.md, grading/work/g-api-result.json, g-api2-result.json, g-web-result.json, g-web2-result.json, g-m6-result.json, m8-digest-result.json.

O2.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and the 90 anchor ("only cosmetic nits"), interpolated close to 90.
O2.justification: No blocker or major defect was found beyond the checklist, and no wrong data, broken flow or crash anywhere. Ten trust-boundary checks plus a dedicated time-seam follow-up all came back clean: cross-user DM reads return zero rows and cross-user writes refuse NOT_MEMBER; a removed member is cut off for reads, history and writes; non-senders cannot edit or delete; non-members cannot read, rename or self-add to a group; view-once is one view per recipient with E_ASSET_UNKNOWN for non-members; the 8-character password floor is enforced server-side; handle uniqueness, handle format and bio length are refused server-side; tombstones leave search. Server time is authoritative - a backdated top-level now, a nested now argument and a ?now= query all still refused EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED. Feed cursors are stable: zero duplicate event ids and no gaps across 19 pages, unchanged with writes injected mid-walk. Group aggregate receipts wait for the slowest member and use membership at send time; the read watermark is monotonic under a backward acknowledge. The three minor findings are one UI-kit-conformance deviation against a brief clause the brief states by name (d-01) and two replay-tooling integrity issues (d-02 receipts that cannot be distinguished from a genuine settle log, d-03 non-idempotent re-replay); the remaining two are cosmetic. That is slightly short of "only cosmetic nits" and far better than "a few medium defects off the happy path".

O4.anchorsCited: Below the 30 anchor ("cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app"), measured against the 90 anchor ("reads, ordered queued writes, receipt transitions, and offline search all behave as specced on the native proof - on full runs including M8's durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence").
O4.justification: applicability.json makes O4 applicable (M6 is green) and restricts it to the harness's mechanically checkable simulator choreography artifacts - recordings plus structured receipts - never builder assertions. That evidence base is empty: there is no m6-ios-screen.mp4, no m6-ios-receipts.jsonl, no m6-ios-run.json, no m8-ios equivalents, and scripts/choreo.mjs passes no --simulator-status, so no supplementalExternal entry exists in any segment summary. The artifacts/mN-ios directories are `expo export` Hermes bundles (only .hbc, metadata.json and assets; the ios build logs show export, never an install), and the lane's cold-offline evidence is explicitly labelled platform:"web", restart:"page reload offline". None of the nine native assertions is therefore demonstrated, which sits below even the 30 anchor - that anchor presupposes a native cold-start observation, however bad. The score is lifted off the floor entirely by the dimension's honesty clause, on which the lane is exemplary: README states "Each artifacts/mN-ios is a Hermes export, not an installed simulator proof", the offline probe receipts self-label their carrier, and no simulator pass is claimed or implied anywhere.
